# AppBarButton

Header: `winui/ui/menus/AppBarButton.hpp`. Spec: `winui/ui/menus/AppBarButton.hpp`.

A command-bar button: an icon over a small label that changes shape with where it sits.

On its own it is full size: 68 DIPs wide, at least 64 tall, with the label under the icon. Inside a [CommandBar](command-bar.md#uicommandbar) the bar sets its look. It is compact while the bar is closed, with the label on the right or hidden as the bar's default says, or a full-width row in the overflow menu with icon, check and shortcut columns. A [Command](../tree/command.md) fills in the text, icon, shortcut and tooltip the button leaves unset and follows their changes. The command runs after the click handler and disables the button while the command is disabled. The shortcut fires app-wide. Clicking a command in a bar closes the bar.

Example: 
```cpp
auto bar = std::make_unique<ui::CommandBarControl>();
auto* save = bar->add_primary(std::make_unique<ui::AppBarButtonControl>("Save", ui::Symbol::Save));
save->set_shortcut(ui::Ctrl + ui::Key::S); // tooltip reads "Save (Ctrl+S)"
save->on_click([] { /* save */ });

auto* share = bar->add_secondary(std::make_unique<ui::AppBarButtonControl>("Share", ui::Symbol::Share));
share->set_text_position(ui::CommandBarTextPosition::Collapsed);
window.set_content(std::move(bar));

// Declaratively:
window.set_content(ui::CommandBar{
    .primary = {ui::AppBarButton{.text     = "Save",
                                 .icon     = ui::Symbol::Save,
                                 .shortcut = ui::Ctrl + ui::Key::S,
                                 .on_click = [] { /* save */ }}},
});
```

## `ui::AppBarButton`

A command-bar button: an icon over a small label. Builds a [ui::AppBarButtonControl](#uiappbarbuttoncontrol). On its own it is full size (68 by 64 DIPs, the label under the icon). In a [ui::CommandBar](command-bar.md#uicommandbar) the bar sets its look.

Example: 
```cpp
window.set_content(ui::CommandBar{
    .primary = {
        ui::AppBarButton{ .text     = "Save",
                          .icon     = ui::Symbol::Save,
                          .shortcut = ui::Ctrl + ui::Key::S,
                          .on_click = [&] { save(); } },
        ui::AppBarButton{ .text = "Share", .icon = ui::Symbol::Share },
    },
});
```

## `ui::AppBarToggleButton`

A command-bar button that stays pressed. Builds a [ui::AppBarToggleButtonControl](#class-appbartogglebuttoncontrol). Apart from the checked state it works like [ui::AppBarButton](#uiappbarbutton). [`.checked`](#uiappbartogglebutton-checked) bound with [ui::bind()](../core/namespace-ui.md#bind) to a [`Property<std::optional<bool>>`](../core/property.md) is two-way: a click writes the new state back.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<std::optional<bool>> bold{false};

window.set_content(ui::CommandBar{
    .primary = {
        ui::AppBarToggleButton{ .text     = "Bold",
                                .checked  = bold,
                                .icon     = ui::Symbol::Bold,
                                .shortcut = ui::Ctrl + ui::Key::B },
    },
});
```

```cpp
}
```

## `ui::AppBarButtonControl`

Derives from `ui::ButtonControl`, `ui::CommandBarElement`.

A command-bar button: an icon over a small label that changes shape with where it sits.

On its own it is full size: 68 DIPs wide, at least 64 tall, with the label under the icon. Inside a [CommandBar](command-bar.md#uicommandbar) the bar sets its look. It is compact while the bar is closed, with the label on the right or hidden as the bar's default says, or a full-width row in the overflow menu with icon, check and shortcut columns. A [Command](../tree/command.md) fills in the text, icon, shortcut and tooltip the button leaves unset and follows their changes. The command runs after the click handler and disables the button while the command is disabled. The shortcut fires app-wide. Clicking a command in a bar closes the bar.

Example: 
```cpp
auto bar = std::make_unique<ui::CommandBarControl>();
auto* save = bar->add_primary(std::make_unique<ui::AppBarButtonControl>("Save", ui::Symbol::Save));
save->set_shortcut(ui::Ctrl + ui::Key::S); // tooltip reads "Save (Ctrl+S)"
save->on_click([] { /* save */ });

auto* share = bar->add_secondary(std::make_unique<ui::AppBarButtonControl>("Share", ui::Symbol::Share));
share->set_text_position(ui::CommandBarTextPosition::Collapsed);
window.set_content(std::move(bar));

// Declaratively:
window.set_content(ui::CommandBar{
    .primary = {ui::AppBarButton{.text     = "Save",
                                 .icon     = ui::Symbol::Save,
                                 .shortcut = ui::Ctrl + ui::Key::S,
                                 .on_click = [] { /* save */ }}},
});
```

## class AppBarToggleButtonControl

Derives from `ui::AppBarButtonControl`, `ui::ToggleProvider`.

An app-bar button with a checked state, drawn as the accent button in the bar and as a check mark in the overflow.

A click advances the checked state (unchecked, checked, then indeterminate when [three_state()](#three_state)) and fires [on_checked_changed()](#on_checked_changed).

Example: 
```cpp
auto bar  = std::make_unique<ui::CommandBarControl>();
auto* bold = bar->add_primary(std::make_unique<ui::AppBarToggleButtonControl>("Bold", ui::Symbol::Bold));
bold->set_shortcut(ui::Ctrl + ui::Key::B);
bold->on_checked_changed([](std::optional<bool> on) { /* apply bold when on == true */ });
window.set_content(std::move(bar));

// Declaratively, bound to state:
ui::Property<std::optional<bool>> is_bold{false};
window.set_content(ui::CommandBar{
    .primary = {ui::AppBarToggleButton{.text               = "Bold",
                                       .checked            = is_bold,
                                       .icon               = ui::Symbol::Bold,
                                       .on_checked_changed = [&](std::optional<bool> on) { is_bold = on; }}},
});
```

### AppBarToggleButtonControl

```cpp
AppBarToggleButtonControl()
```

An empty, unchecked toggle.

### AppBarToggleButtonControl

```cpp
AppBarToggleButtonControl(std::string text, IconSource icon = {}, std::optional<bool> checked = false)
```

A toggle showing [`text`](#text) under [`icon`](#icon), starting at [`checked`](#checked) (nullopt is indeterminate).


The checked state: true, false, or nullopt for indeterminate. Default false.

### set_checked





```cpp

```

### on_activated

```cpp
void on_activated() override
```

Advances the checked state, then closes the holding bar as [AppBarButton](#uiappbarbutton) does.

### toggle_state

```cpp
std::optional<std::optional<bool>> toggle_state() const override
```

[checked()](#checked), so the shared rendering draws the checked look.

## class AppBarSeparatorControl

Derives from `ui::Element`, `ui::CommandBarElement`.

A 1px rule in the theme's divider color: vertical between groups of commands in the bar (padding 2,8,2,8), horizontal across the overflow menu (0,4,0,4 around it).

Example: 
```cpp
auto bar = std::make_unique<ui::CommandBarControl>();
bar->add_primary(std::make_unique<ui::AppBarButtonControl>("Cut", ui::Symbol::Cut));
bar->add_primary(std::make_unique<ui::AppBarButtonControl>("Copy", ui::Symbol::Copy));
bar->add_primary(std::make_unique<ui::AppBarSeparatorControl>());
bar->add_primary(std::make_unique<ui::AppBarButtonControl>("Delete", ui::Symbol::Delete));
```

```cpp
AppBarSeparatorControl() = default
```

A separator; its orientation follows the look the bar sets.

```cpp
void set_app_bar_look(const AppBarLook& look) override
```

Switches between the bar's vertical rule and the overflow's horizontal one, and updates the layout.

### is_separator

```cpp
bool is_separator() const override
```

Always true.



## class CommandBarElement

What a [CommandBar](command-bar.md#uicommandbar) needs of the things in it: the look it pushes down, the overflow order and the facts the overflow menu sizes its columns by. Mixed into [AppBarButton](#uiappbarbutton), [AppBarToggleButton](#uiappbartogglebutton) and [AppBarSeparator](#uiappbarseparator); use [command_bar_element()](#command_bar_element) to reach it from an [Element](../tree/element.md).

### dynamic_overflow_order

```cpp
int dynamic_overflow_order() const
```

Which commands move into the overflow first when the bar runs out of room. The lowest positive order goes first, a whole group at once, and 0 goes last, from the right.

## struct AppBarLook

How the [CommandBar](command-bar.md#uicommandbar) holding an app-bar element wants it drawn. A button on its own keeps the default: full size, text at the bottom. The bar pushes one down with [CommandBarElement::set_app_bar_look()](#set_app_bar_look) whenever its state changes; apps rarely build one.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `compact` | `bool` | `false` | the bar is closed |
| `text_position` | `CommandBarDefaultTextPosition` | `CommandBarDefaultTextPosition::Bottom` | the bar's text position |
| `overflow` | `bool` | `false` | a row of the overflow menu |
| `overflow_icons` | `bool` | `false` | some overflow item has an icon |
| `overflow_toggles` | `bool` | `false` | some overflow item is a toggle button |
| `overflow_shortcut_width` | `float` | `0.0f` | the widest shortcut text in the overflow |
| `flyout_primary` | `bool` | `false` | a [CommandBarFlyout](command-bar-flyout.md#uicommandbarflyout)'s primary row: icon-only, 40x40 |
| `flyout_overflow` | `bool` | `false` | With [`overflow`](#struct-appbarlook): a row of a [CommandBarFlyout](command-bar-flyout.md#uicommandbarflyout)'s secondary menu, which is laid out a little differently from a [CommandBar](command-bar.md#uicommandbar)'s overflow row. |

## class AppBarCommandHost

What holds app-bar commands (a [CommandBar](command-bar.md#uicommandbar), a [CommandBarFlyout](command-bar-flyout.md#uicommandbarflyout)): told when one is clicked, so a bar can close after a click on one of its commands. Implement it only for a custom command container, and register it on each element with [CommandBarElement::set_command_host()](#set_command_host).

### command_invoked

```cpp
virtual void command_invoked(CommandBarElement& command) = 0
```

Called after `command`'s own click handler and command have run.

### ~AppBarCommandHost

```cpp
~AppBarCommandHost() = default
```

## Enumerations

### CommandBarDefaultTextPosition

```cpp
enum class CommandBarDefaultTextPosition
```

Where a [CommandBar](command-bar.md#uicommandbar) puts its buttons' text.

| Value | |
| --- | --- |
| `Bottom` | Under the icon, revealed when the bar opens; the default. |
| `Right` | Beside the icon, always visible. |
| `Collapsed` | No text at all. |

### CommandBarTextPosition

```cpp
enum class CommandBarTextPosition
```

Where one button puts its text. Collapsed hides it wherever the bar puts text, Default follows the bar.

| Value | |
| --- | --- |
| `Default` | Follow the bar's [CommandBarDefaultTextPosition](#commandbardefaulttextposition). |
| `Collapsed` | Never show this button's text. |
